verdict.rationale: Docusaurus is a local project scaffolded with create-docusaurus. Docs are plain MDX/Markdown files in a `docs` directory that get built into static HTML with `npm run build`. That build deploys to git-connected hosts like GitHub Pages, Netlify and Vercel, and the community confirms docs-as-code use with builds running in GitHub Actions. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of branch/pull-request-driven workflows (PR preview deploys, publish-on-merge), and first-party guidance tying git merges to publishing.
